summary: Apollo Debt Solutions BDC filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of 469,341 unregistered Class I common shares for $11,160,167 (about $23.78 per share, matching the September 30 NAV), sold as of October 1, 2026 to feeder vehicles under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S. The same filing disclosed October distributions of $0.1800 gross per share across Class I, S and D (net $0.1800/$0.1628/$0.1750), payable November 27, 2026 to holders of record October 31, plus portfolio commentary. No special-situation event, board recommendation, advisor or deal clock is present.
